inputs.text: [excited] It was 9.5 meters long — as long as a truck! [quickly] Standing up, it was 3 meters tall — as tall as a basketball hoop! And it weighed 2,000 kilos — as heavy as a rhino! [amazed] And scientists think it could run about 19 miles an hour — as fast as a horse cantering.
[curious] What about its arms? [playful] Tiny, like T. rex?
[confident] Yes, just the same: tiny, [amazed] with only TWO fingers on each hand.
